text:
This week, ROBI handled a total of 382 orders with an average fetch time of 42 seconds and a median of 24 seconds per order. Despite the high volume, we managed to deliver 128 orders without any warnings, which is commendable given the number of failures we experienced. The most challenging day was May 18th when ROBI had to process all 382 orders efficiently.

Notably, there were significant patterns in both successes and challenges. Failures such as [[reachability]]_failed (67), unknown (128), no_valid_depth (63), [[handover]]_failed (62), and search_exhausted (62) required careful attention to resolve. ROBI also needed a total of 264 retries across the 132 orders that required them, highlighting the importance of continuous improvement in our processes. Additionally, we received 1324 collision warnings from customers, underscoring the need for continued training and adjustments to ensure safe interactions with humans.

These statistics underscore both ROBI's capabilities and areas where we can improve to better serve our customers efficiently and safely.
